title: ARGUS prospective bootstrap uncertainty for impact calibration verified
summary: ARGUS now supports a separately pre-registered deterministic bootstrap uncertainty addendum for prospective impact-calibration studies without changing the stable study-v1 manifest. The plan pins confidence alpha, replicate count, deterministic seed, metric set and minimum eligible observations before the cohort begins. Bootstrap uncertainty is computed separately by execution-evidence class, excludes zero-fill rows from slippage metrics without inventing values, and is explicitly descriptive percentile uncertainty rather than hypothesis testing, simultaneous coverage, multiplicity-adjusted inference or causal estimation.
